sources.beginner: No NextGen route: the pump explorer (panels/rotating/PumpExplorer.jsx) has only a View select and teaches on OKONO. The engine runs on the capstone case only in the Suite Pump Station Designer (named in beginner m01/l01), which prints duty flow and head fmt(v, 0) and power fmt(v, 1) (src/components/pumpstudio/PumpPanels.jsx:101-110) and no discharge pressure; the power and pressure conversions (3960, 2.31, 0.7457) are hand steps taught in m04 but need the duty at full precision.
sources.intermediate: Suction figures are closed forms taught in intermediate (pressure head (Ps - Pv) x 2.31 / SG, NPSHa = pressure head + static - friction), full precision by hand. The speed-mapped duty and the parallel duty need the solved crossing, available only from the Suite Pump Station Designer's 'What a change would buy' card at fmt(v, 0) (PumpPanels.jsx:241-260).
sources.advanced: Exponent ratio, ratio per stage and first-stage discharge temperature are closed forms taught in advanced m01-m03 (459.67 Rankine offset quoted in m04/l04). Polytropic head, gas hp and fuel need DAK Z (engine-only); the Suite Compressor Station Designer prints them at 0, 0 and 3 decimals (src/components/compressorstudio/CompressorPanels.jsx:121, :152, :204). The NextGen CompressorExplorer has no numeric inputs.

fields.prompt_precision: Flows in gpm, heads in ft, power in hp and kW, and pressure in psi, to six decimals

fix.display: src/components/pumpstudio/PumpPanels.jsx:101-110, :241-260 -> print duty flow, duty head, hydraulic hp, brake hp and motor input kW with fmt(v, 6), and add a discharge pressure (psi) Stat at the duty at 6 decimals (PumpStationDesigner.jsx:38-42 mirror the same rows)

fields.recommendation: Display fix in the Suite Pump Station Designer, the only place a learner can run this pump chain on the capstone case: the NextGen pump and suction explorers have no numeric inputs (a View select only) and teach on OKONO, and the least-squares fit plus crossing are engine steps the lessons describe but do not teach as a hand procedure. The Designer prints duty flow and head with 0 decimals and power with 1 (PumpPanels.jsx:101-110), against a prompt that asks six decimals. An alternative is editable inputs on the NextGen pump explorer printing six decimals as its tiles already do; a tolerance change cannot help without swallowing the method errors the tier grades.
fields.evidence: With Full precision on, prints at 6 decimals (jest: rotatingFullPrecision.test.jsx, the engine result through formatFull).

shipped.prompt_append: Read the figures in the Pump Station Designer with its Full precision switch on (at the top of the page): it prints them to the precision this capstone grades, with no digit grouping.

fields.prompt_precision: The exponent ratio ... to nine decimals
fields.evidence: (k - 1) / (k x eta_p) = 0.272 / (1.272 x 0.767) = 0.278795930 at nine decimals, within tol 5e-10 (exactly half a unit). The Designer does not print it.

fields.prompt_precision: the ratio per stage ... to nine decimals
fields.evidence: Three stages are forced (two stages give 2.9976 per stage but a first-stage discharge near 295 degF, above 285); (1240 / 138)^(1/3) = 2.078966699, within tol 1e-9. The Designer's 2-decimal 2.08 would fail, the taught closed form passes.
fields.notes: The stage count itself is read from the Designer's stage table or reasoned from the two limits as taught.

fields.prompt_precision: Temperatures in degF ... to four decimals
fields.evidence: (96 + 459.67) x 2.078967^0.278796 - 459.67 = 221.7762 degF, closed form with the 459.67 offset quoted in m04/l04; the Designer's stage table prints 222.

fields.prompt_precision: heads in ft lbf per lbm ... to four decimals
fields.recommendation: Display fix in the Suite Compressor Station Designer. The polytropic head, gas horsepower and fuel need Z by Dranchuk-Abou-Kassem at both ends of the stage, an engine-only iteration; the NextGen compressor explorer has no numeric inputs. The Designer prints the first-stage polytropic head with 0 decimals (CompressorPanels.jsx:152), stage gas hp with 0 (:121) and fuel with 3 (:204), against a prompt that asks four and nine.
fields.evidence: With Full precision on, prints at 6 decimals (jest: rotatingFullPrecision.test.jsx, the engine result through formatFull).
